{'空': False, 'text': 'Apple Maps ads are coming, and Apple is revealing the prohibited categories'}

{'空': False, 'text': 'Apple first announced plans to bring ads to Apple Maps back in March. At the time, the company said that ads would appear at the top of search results, as well as in a brand new "Suggested Places" widget within the app.'}

{'空': False, 'text': "Apple laid the groundwork for the feature in May with iOS 26.5, which included the new Suggested Places functionality. However, the company hasn't shared a launch timeline for Apple Maps ads since then."}

{'空': False, 'text': 'As spotted by TechCrunch, Apple has now published an updated version of its "Apple Advertising Services" policies, which contain new information about Apple Maps ads.'}

{'空': False, 'text': 'The policies cover advertising guidelines for services including Apple News, Stocks, and Maps, and list a long list of prohibited content that applies to ads across all services, including violence, weapons, drugs, and more.'}

{'空': False, 'text': 'Most notably, the policies reveal additional restrictions for Apple Maps ads. According to Apple, there are three additional prohibited categories for ads within Apple Maps specifically:'}

  • {'空': False, 'text': 'Home services: Any ad content that contains or directly or indirectly advertises home services, including but not limited to plumbing, locksmiths, HVAC, pest control, roofing, or general contracting, is prohibited.'}
  • {'空': False, 'text': 'Bail bonds: Any ad content that contains or directly or indirectly advertises bail bond or guarantee bond services related to pretrial release from criminal custody is prohibited.'}
  • {'空': False, 'text': 'Crypto ATMs: Any ad content that contains or directly or indirectly advertises cryptocurrency ATMs is prohibited.'}

{'空': False, 'text': 'Additionally, Apple says that ads related to medical services will be evaluated on a "case-by-case" basis.'}

{'空': False, 'text': 'As TechCrunch points out, Apple\'s blanket ban on the entire "home services" ad category is interesting. This is a major ad business on Google Maps, but Apple is clearly not interested in it.'}

{'空': False, 'text': "All of this signals that Apple is getting ready to launch ads in Apple Maps very soon. As of right now, though, there's still no official launch date."}

{'空': False, 'text': "You can check out the full list of prohibited ad categories for all Apple services on Apple's website."}
